doNotDeployFromThisArtifactAlone: Parent connector performs the only deployment. This file is the request recipe. It does not contain an API token.

verified.note: This repo has no package.json wrangler pin and deploys with npx wrangler. run_worker_first arrays exist in Wrangler since 4.20.0. The hash below is hashFile from wrangler 4.158.0 deploy-helpers. The Workers script-upload schema says boolean true is equivalent to ["/*"], negative rules must start with "!/", and a negative-only list is rejected.

preserve.htmlHandling: omit so the platform default auto-trailing-slash stays in effect
preserve.doNotReadOrWrite: javid-live-captures object data. The binding must stay on the Worker and must not be made public.

preflight: GET /accounts/{account_id}/workers/scripts/javid-hub-landing/deployments and save the version id that has 100% traffic.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/workers/scripts/javid-hub-landing/settings and abort unless the live bindings are exactly ASSETS, LIVE_CAPTURES on bucket javid-live-captures, and BOARD_DB on database 984b1bcb-c257-496e-b5c4-6c73a1c1b994, plus existing secrets. Abort if any other binding would be dropped.
Do not call DNS, route, or certificate APIs.

assets.manifestShape: The session body is the manifest object only: { "manifest": { "/path": { "hash", "size" } } }. Drop contentType from the upload plan before that POST.
assets.hash: blake3(base64(raw bytes) + file extension without the dot) as hex, first 32 characters. Extension for a .png file is the string png. This matches wrangler 4.158.0 and is not SHA-256 of the raw bytes.
assets.contentType: mime@4.0.7 getType, then append '; charset=utf-8' when the type starts with text/ and has no charset. PNG cards are image/png. Use that as the upload part Content-Type. application/null means send no content type.
assets.fullTreeRequired: The manifest lists every public file, not only /blog-media. A manifest of the two cards would replace the site with those two files.

upload.permission: Workers Scripts Write on the account token. File bytes use the upload-session JWT, not the account token.

steps.when: Session result.buckets is non-empty AND the session JWT payload does not set wrangler_single_asset_uploads to true.
steps.body: multipart/form-data. One part per hash in that bucket. Field name is the hash. Field value is base64 of the raw file. Part Content-Type is the plan contentType. Repeat once per bucket. A 201 response carries result.jwt, the completion token.

steps.when: Session JWT payload wrangler_single_asset_uploads is true (wrangler 4.158 takes this branch). One request per hash, raw bytes, Content-Type from the plan, Authorization Bearer session jwt.
buckets is empty. The session jwt is already the completion token.

scriptUpload.note: This PUT publishes the version. Upload hub-site/deploy/javid-hub-landing.worker.js, which is the wrangler 4.158.0 dry-run bundle of worker.js and its imports. Uploading the unbundled worker.js source fails because of those imports. Regenerate the bundle with: cd hub-site && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir <dir> --name javid-hub-landing

config._headers:
/*
  X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
  Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin
  Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()
  X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN

/assets/*
  Cache-Control: public, max-age=604800

routing.why: true is ["/*"]. The negative rule wins, so /blog-media/* is served by the asset worker with no Worker invocation and no Worker request charge. Every other path still invokes the Worker first, including the apex-host 301 and the APIs.
routing.apexTradeoff: A request to https://javidtrading.com/blog-media/<card>.png is served directly and is not 301'd to www, because the Worker does not run. Publishers must use the www URL. Other apex paths still 301.
routing.cache: Cards keep the asset default Cache-Control: public, max-age=0, must-revalidate, plus an ETag. Replacing a file and redeploying updates the same URL. /assets/* keeps its seven-day cache. Do not mark cards immutable.

afterDeploy: GET https://www.javidtrading.com/api/live-capture/latest returns JSON and does not return an object from the private bucket
GET https://www.javidtrading.com/blog-media/acct_20261107_en_1_calendar.png returns 200 image/png and the PNG signature
GET https://www.javidtrading.com/blog-media/acct_20261107_ko_1_calendar.png does not return an image
POST https://www.javidtrading.com/blog-media/acct_20261107_en_1_calendar.png does not store a body

rollback.before: The preflight deployment version id is the rollback target.
rollback.action: POST /accounts/{account_id}/workers/scripts/javid-hub-landing/deployments with strategy percentage and that version id at 100. Equivalent CLI, from hub-site: npx wrangler rollback --name javid-hub-landing
rollback.effect: Worker code, run_worker_first, and the asset set roll back together. Card URLs then 404. D1, the R2 bucket, secrets, routes, and DNS are not rolled back and must not be deleted.
rollback.doNot: Do not delete javid-live-captures. Do not set keep_assets on a code-only rollback if the goal is to return to the previous asset set.
